description: JavaScript functions supporting the JWQL web application, including image display, filtering, sorting, and AJAX page updates.

methods.name: change_filetype
methods.description: Updates the displayed image and related UI elements based on selected file type and integration.

methods.name: change_int
methods.description: Changes the displayed image to a different integration based on user interaction.

methods.name: determine_filetype_for_thumbnail
methods.description: Sets the thumbnail image source based on available suffixes.

methods.name: determine_page_title
methods.description: Sets the page title based on URL context and instrument/proposal.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Filters thumbnails based on search input.

methods.name: show_only
methods.description: Filters thumbnails based on selected filter criteria.

methods.name: sort_by_proposals
methods.description: Sorts proposal thumbnails by ascending or descending order.

methods.name: sort_by_thumbnails
methods.description: Sorts thumbnail images by name, default, or exposure start time.

methods.name: update_archive_page
methods.description: Fetches and displays archive proposals and thumbnails via AJAX.

methods.name: update_filter_options
methods.description: Updates filter dropdowns based on AJAX data.

methods.name: update_header_display
methods.description: Shows the selected header extension and hides others.

methods.name: update_show_count
methods.description: Updates the display of the number of shown items.

methods.name: update_sort_options
methods.description: Updates sorting options in the UI.

methods.name: update_thumbnail_array
methods.description: Populates the thumbnail grid with data and images.

methods.name: update_thumbnails_page
methods.description: Fetches and updates the thumbnails page via AJAX.

methods.name: update_thumbnails_query_page
methods.description: Fetches and updates the query results page via AJAX.

methods.name: version_url
methods.description: Constructs a URL to a specific GitHub release page.
